facts.content: The round method returns a long. Implicit casting cannot store a long (8 bytes) into an int (4 bytes). Explicit casting can be used to convert a long to an int when the value fits. The result of Math.round(Math.random() * 100) is a number between 0 and 100. A number between 0 and 100 can be stored in an int.
